verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own docs say evaluations on curated datasets are used to "compare versions, benchmark performance, and catch regressions". Running an application on a dataset produces an experiment, pairwise-comparison evaluators are supported, and traces can be compared via the UI or API. Together this covers the core of comparing prompt or model versions to catch regressions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a side-by-side experiment comparison view (diffing metrics and outputs per example across runs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the comparison workflow.
